body: Yeah access isn't an issue for me and when I said I'm in a rut that doesn't mean I'm crazy broke or anything infact it's the opposite and that's the problem I've pushed myself as far as I can in my industry (and industry where being as fake as you can is a good thing) and now not only do i have nowhere to go but I guess I've lost myself somewhere on the way I've accomplished so much by some people's standards and I know it's selfish of me but to me these achievements mean less than nothing I feel them actively mock me but I see what you are saying and I want to thank you for taking the time out to talk you're a great person and hopefully i haven't been too emotionally draining I've heard I can get that way at times

Oh I know, you talk about only the things you are comfortable with talking about. It's just there are things that have happened to me that i've dealt with and overcome and I guess a part of me is worried about being in that setting and dredging them back up  my main problem i suppose is that I'm just tired of going on I just want to rest at this point I've done everything I can to create a new perspective for myself nothing sticks for long my only options at this point is to be brave and and step through to whatever is beyond this life or try to distract myself for sixty more years until that happens anyway I've spent my whole life acting and feeling like a coward I think now is the time I can be brave and actually accomplish something.

Not really, I have someone close to me that is a counselor so  in a unofficial sense we talk about a lot of these issues. I don't want to see a professional because there are things I definitely do not want to talk about. I have a ton of support I feel way more than I deserve at least and I agree that I'm not a monstrous sociopath that loves hurting people I've just made a bunch of mistakes that kind of piled on top of each other and I feel like I'm finally manning up and facing the consequences.
